description: Offline CVE correlation map. A match only means the fingerprinted version falls inside the affected range; it is a potential exposure, never a confirmed vulnerability.

nginx.summary: Off-by-one in the DNS resolver allows a one-byte memory overwrite.

apache http server.summary: Path traversal and remote code execution in the default configuration.
Possible source code disclosure through malformed request handling.

microsoft iis.summary: HTTP protocol stack remote code execution.

php.summary: CGI argument injection on Windows leading to code execution.

jquery.summary: HTML passed to jQuery DOM manipulation methods may execute script.
Prototype pollution through jQuery.extend with deep merge.

bootstrap.summary: Cross-site scripting in the tooltip and popover data attributes.

wordpress.summary: Directory traversal in the core translation file loader.

drupal.summary: Uploaded file names may be executed in some configurations.

joomla.summary: Improper access control on the webservice API exposes configuration.

express.summary: Open redirect through malformed URL handling in res.location.

tomcat.summary: Ghostcat AJP file read and possible code execution.

jenkins.summary: Arbitrary file read through the CLI command parser.

gitlab.summary: Account takeover via password reset to an unverified address.

grafana.summary: Path traversal in the plugin endpoint allows arbitrary file read.

kibana.summary: Prototype pollution leading to remote code execution.

elasticsearch.summary: Groovy sandbox bypass enabling remote code execution.

vue.js.summary: Prototype pollution in the template compiler.

laravel.summary: Ignition debug mode allows unauthenticated remote code execution.

spring boot.summary: Spring4Shell data binding remote code execution.
